spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact prototype accessor and mirrors the constructor's satisfied-or-default resolution step; readback is sampled synchronously at construction as the spec defines.

interactive.rationale: One-press probe plus a per-enum-value constructor run filling a requested-vs-satisfied table from real instances.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises descriptor dump plus per-enum readback at construction; delivered exactly.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the attribute-missing build, constructor-throw rows, and an out-of-contract-value branch that would flag a non-conforming answer.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the exact spec anchor in see-also.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite checks the accessor descriptor, default value, satisfied-or-default for both non-default enum values, TypeError on invalid enum, and strict-mode write; verified executing on the live /conformance/ route (0 pass / 8 fail on this build, honest).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chromium 141 (predates Chrome 158, feature absent even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features) via Playwright 1.56 at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, driving every control; screenshots under /tmp/claude-0/agentB/shots/. Readback table showed undefined for all three requests and the output names it the honest pre-158 answer; the satisfied/granted path could not run here.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the explicit fallback branch; console output is intentional and prefixed.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css; buttons overriding background also set color; AA pairs (text-charcoal/bg-stone, bg-ivory/text-black, accent-emerald-dark on paper).

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, visible focus (verified first-Tab), caption+scope tables, aria-live polite result regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports exercised: table scrolls inside its wrapper, no horizontal overflow, 44px buttons.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on a real Chrome 158 / Canary build
openQuestions.detail: This environment's Chromium 141 lacks the surface even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so only the honest-absent branch ran. On Chrome 158 (or Canary with the feature's runtime flag) verify: the attribute returns the requested value or 'default' synchronously, and whether Chromium grants 'throughput' and/or 'low-latency'.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsically-sized grid/flex layouts (auto-fit + minmax) so panels reflow without horizontal overflow at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control panels use grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax()), tables are wrapped in overflow-x containers, and long tokens use overflow-wrap: anywhere; verified no horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Landmarks, native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, and polite live regions for asynchronous state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Content sits in main/header/footer landmarks; async results land in aria-live=polite output/status elements; tables carry caption plus th scope=col; first-Tab focus visibility verified in the browser.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled controls with adequate touch targets and visible hints for constraints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native button/select/input/radio elements with <label for> associations, min-height 44px, and inline constraint hints.

summary: Exact-surface probe plus real per-enum constructor readback; on Chromium 141 every branch behaves and labels itself honestly.
